what: The head angles each character's projection survives, in degrees, measured by eye. Not a clamp and not read by anything yet: a record of where each asset stops reading as a head that turned.
units: degrees from rest, either side, per axis driven alone from rest

measured.how: static held pose, one axis at a time from rest, judged by eye at the shipping surface
measured.safe: reads as a head that turned, with nothing to notice
measured.limit: the last angle before something is visibly wrong

defects.what: the eye does not foreshorten or narrow; it is what gives the turn away first
the transition reads as a hinge rather than a neck bending, at any angle
